en: A monochrome cityscape view printed in an old-photographic style. In the foreground a river curves past a stone embankment and a multi‑arch bridge. On the right stands a large brick industrial or civic building with tall arched windows. Across the river are late‑19th‑century townhouses and commercial buildings, with a tall factory chimney and a church spire rising above the roofs. Hills form the hazy background. The title in red Gothic‑style type at the top left reads "Blick auf Aue i. Erzgeb."
